train_eval: First sentence; free budget = number of remaining excerpt tokens. EOS not taught, no inference of document ending.
dev_eval: Original 128 token budget and caption32 original limits.
order: fixed TRAIN order; cycle four batches 75 times
loss: mean over active shifted positions; A all, B continuation only
primary: Two newly generated complete, natural, connected topical sentences; reference mismatch alone is not failure. Ignore supplied tokens, reject loops/nonsense. Log first mechanically repeated autonomous 4gram separately from harmful repetition.
stop: Stop on nonfinite gradient/parameters, failed resume equivalence, digest or disk failure. No outcome-dependent changes.
